assumptions.budget_attention: Uniform(0.35, 0.9); probability of trying to repair an over-budget plan.
assumptions.budget_repair: Check triangular(10,50,20). With budget-attention probability attempt 1..3 cheaper swaps of the most expensive dinner. Each swap takes lognormal(log(50),0.5) browsing plus 15 seconds review, scaled by personal traits.
assumptions.carefulness: Lognormal(0, 0.25), clamped to 0.6..1.7; shared across both tasks.
assumptions.manual: Setup uniform(20,50); each meal browse lognormal(log(60),0.5), review triangular(8,35,18), record uniform(8,18). 15% chance of backtracking uniform(30,80).
assumptions.pace: Lognormal(0, 0.25), clamped to 0.55..1.9; shared across both tasks.
assumptions.patience_seconds: Uniform integer 700..1200; shared across tasks; truncate last event.
assumptions.practice: Human actions in the second task take 92% as long; generation waits unaffected.
assumptions.preferences: 30% vegetarian; one restriction sampled from none, milk, peanuts, wheat.
assumptions.prices: One serving per dinner; no taxes or fees; all items available and restaurants open.
assumptions.provenance: Fictional users and menu; neither the app nor a model is executed.
assumptions.scaling: Browsing/setup/recording use pace; reviews/checks use carefulness; all human actions include practice multiplier.
assumptions.selection: Shared item tastes uniform(0.5,1.5); preferred cuisine doubles weight. Weight = taste * cuisine factor / dollar price ** pressure; pressure is attention * 0.8 manually and attention * 2 with Weeklies. Repeats allowed.
assumptions.weeklies: Setup uniform(35,75); wait lognormal(log(45),0.6), with 12% chance of a uniform(3,6) multiplier. Each meal review triangular(10,50,20), record uniform(5,12). Shared rejection chance uniform(0.12,0.38); replacement browse triangular(25,130,55) followed by another review.
